resend.document:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Resend email API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: The Resend operations this pack uses. Sending is a reviewed action; the rest are reads.
servers:
  - url: https://api.resend.com
security:
  - bearer: []
paths:
  /emails:
    post:
      operationId: sendEmail
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: false
          schema: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 256 }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SendEmailRequest" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Email accepted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id]
                properties:
                  id: { type: string }
  /emails/{email_id}:
    get:
      operationId: getEmail
      parameters:
        - { name: email_id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: A sent email and its latest delivery event
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Email" }
  /templates:
    get:
      operationId: listTemplates
      parameters:
        - { name: after, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Templates
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  object: { type: string }
                  has_more: { type: boolean }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/TemplateSummary" }
  /templates/{template_id}:
    get:
      operationId: getTemplate
      parameters:
        - { name: template_id, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string }, description: Template id or alias }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: A template, its subject, and its variables
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Template" }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearer: { type: http, scheme: bearer }
  schemas:
    # One address, bare or with a display name. Commas are refused, so each
    # list item is one recipient and the policy engine sees every domain.
    Address:
      type: string
      maxLength: 320
      pattern: '^(?:[^<>,@]*<[^@\s<>,]+@[^@\s<>,]+\.[^@\s<>,]+>|[^@\s<>,]+@[^@\s<>,]+\.[^@\s<>,]+)$'
    AddressList:
      type: array
      minItems: 1
      maxItems: 50
      items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Address" }
    SendEmailRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [from, to]
      properties:
        from: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Address" }
        to: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/AddressList" }
        cc: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/AddressList" }
        bcc: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/AddressList" }
        reply_to: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/AddressList" }
        subject: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 998 }
        html: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        text: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        template:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [id]
          properties:
            id: { type: string, minLength: 1, description: Template id or alias }
            variables:
              type: object
              additionalProperties:
                oneOf:
                  - { type: string }
                  - { type: number }
        tags:
          type: array
          maxItems: 10
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [name, value]
            properties:
              name: { type: string, pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}$' }
              value: { type: string, pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}$' }
      # One body: a template, or a subject with html and/or text.
      anyOf:
        - required: [template]
        - required: [subject, html]
        - required: [subject, text]
      not:
        anyOf:
          - required: [template, html]
          - required: [template, text]
    Email:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        to: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        from: { type: string }
        subject: { type: string }
        created_at: { type: string }
        last_event: { type: string }
    TemplateSummary:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        alias: { type: string, nullable: true }
        name: { type: string }
        status: { type: string }
    Template:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        alias: { type: string, nullable: true }
        name: { type: string }
        status: { type: string }
        subject: { type: string, nullable: true }
        variables:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              key: { type: string }
              type: { type: string }
              fallback_value: { nullable: true }

parallel.document:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Parallel Search API
  version: v1beta
  description: Parallel's web search. It reads the open web and changes nothing, but the API takes POST, so it is a reviewed action.
servers:
  - url: https://api.parallel.ai
security:
  - apiKey: []
paths:
  /v1beta/search:
    post:
      operationId: webSearch
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SearchRequest" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Ranked results with excerpts
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  search_id: { type: string }
                  results:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        url: { type: string }
                        title: { type: string, nullable: true }
                        publish_date: { type: string, nullable: true }
                        excerpts: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
                  warnings: { type: array, nullable: true, items: { type: object, additionalProperties: true } }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    apiKey: { type: apiKey, in: header, name: x-api-key }
  schemas:
    SearchRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      anyOf:
        - required: [objective]
        - required: [search_queries]
      properties:
        objective: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 5000, description: The goal of the search in plain language }
        search_queries:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 5
          items: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 200 }
        processor: { type: string, enum: [base, pro] }
        max_results: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 20 }
        max_chars_per_result: { type: integer, minimum: 100, maximum: 30000 }
        source_policy:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          properties:
            include_domains: { type: array, maxItems: 10, items: { type: string } }
            exclude_domains: { type: array, maxItems: 10, items: { type: string } }

gmail.document:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Google Gmail read API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: https://gmail.googleapis.com
security:
  - oauthBearer: []
paths:
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/profile:
    get:
      operationId: getProfile
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Gmail profile
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [emailAddress]
                properties:
                  emailAddress: { type: string }
                  messagesTotal: { type: integer }
                  threadsTotal: { type: integer }
                  historyId: { type: string }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/messages:
    get:
      operationId: listMessages
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: q, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: labelIds, in: query, schema: { type: array, items: { type: string } } }
        - { name: maxResults, in: query, schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 500 } }
        - { name: pageToken, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Message references
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  messages:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/MessageRef" }
                  nextPageToken: { type: string }
                  resultSizeEstimate: { type: integer }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}:
    get:
      operationId: getMessage
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: messageId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: format, in: query, schema: { type: string, enum: [minimal, full, raw, metadata] } }
        - { name: metadataHeaders, in: query, schema: { type: array, items: { type: string } } }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/threads:
    get:
      operationId: listThreads
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: q, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: labelIds, in: query, schema: { type: array, items: { type: string } } }
        - { name: maxResults, in: query, schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 500 } }
        - { name: pageToken, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/threads/{threadId}:
    get:
      operationId: getThread
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: threadId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: format, in: query, schema: { type: string, enum: [full, metadata, minimal] } }
        - { name: metadataHeaders, in: query, schema: { type: array, items: { type: string } } }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}/modify:
    post:
      operationId: modifyMessageLabels
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: messageId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ModifyMessageRequest" }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/messages/send:
    post:
      operationId: sendMessage
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Message" }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/drafts:
    get:
      operationId: listDrafts
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: q, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: maxResults, in: query, schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 500 } }
        - { name: pageToken, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
    post:
      operationId: createDraft
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Draft" }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/drafts/{draftId}:
    get:
      operationId: getDraft
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: draftId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: format, in: query, schema: { type: string, enum: [minimal, full, raw, metadata] } }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/labels:
    get:
      operationId: listLabels
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
    post:
      operationId: createLabel
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Label" }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/labels/{labelId}:
    get:
      operationId: getLabel
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: labelId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
    patch:
      operationId: updateLabel
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: labelId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Label" }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
    delete:
      operationId: deleteLabel
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: labelId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "204": { description: Label deleted }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/history:
    get:
      operationId: listHistory
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: startHistoryId, in: query, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: historyTypes, in: query, schema: { type: array, items: { type: string } } }
        - { name: labelId, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: maxResults, in: query, schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 500 } }
        - { name: pageToken, in: query, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
  /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}/attachments/{attachmentId}:
    get:
      operationId: getAttachment
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/UserId"
        - { name: messageId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
        - { name: attachmentId, in: path, required: true, schema: { type: string } }
      responses:
        "200": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Object" }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    oauthBearer: { type: http, scheme: bearer }
  parameters:
    UserId:
      name: userId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, default: me }
  schemas:
    MessageRef:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        threadId: { type: string }
    Message:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [raw]
      properties:
        raw: { type: string, description: Base64url-encoded RFC 2822 message }
        threadId: { type: string }
    Draft:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [message]
      properties:
        message: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Message" }
    Label:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [name]
      properties:
        name: { type: string }
        messageListVisibility: { type: string, enum: [show, hide] }
        labelListVisibility: { type: string, enum: [labelShow, labelShowIfUnread, labelHide] }
    ModifyMessageRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        addLabelIds: { type: array, items: { type: string }, maxItems: 100 }
        removeLabelIds: { type: array, items: { type: string }, maxItems: 100 }
  responses:
    Object:
      description: Google API response
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }
